title: TestHallVQA：探索LVLM在冗余上下文中的文档级推理能力
summary: 提出TestHallVQA多图像VQA基准，同时涵盖文档级规模与人类考试难度，并支持可控注入多级上下文冗余。提出新指标F1-R²，联合量化LVLM的推理能力与证据检索鲁棒性，揭示主流模型的多维缺陷。
summary_en: Introduces TestHallVQA, a multi-image VQA benchmark combining document-level scale with human exam difficulty, supporting controllable injection of multi-level contextual redundancy. Proposes F1-R², a novel metric jointly quantifying LVLMs' reasoning capability and evidence retrieval robustness, revealing latent deficiencies of mainstream models.
